WHO Infectious Protocol: Insensible fluid losses increase by ~10% for every 1°C increase above normal body temperature; continuous electrolyte replenishment is primary care.

actions.title: Measure Exact Temperature
actions.desc: Use a calibrated digital oral or axillary thermometer to record your exact numerical reading before taking medication.

actions.title: Electrolyte Rehydration
actions.desc: Drink 2.5 to 3 liters of water, ORS solution, clear broths, or coconut water throughout the day.

actions.title: Rest & Ambient Ventilation
actions.desc: Rest in a well-ventilated, ambient temperature room wearing light, breathable clothing.

actions.title: Physician Consultation
actions.desc: Schedule a medical consultation for CBC, dengue, or malarial screening if fever persists over 48 hours.
